tasks.description:
This section is designed to help you with calculations that are running in the background on Google Earth Engine. Here is what you can do:

- **Locate Your Task File**: A unique 'task file' is created for each calculation that was sent to the GEE background, which you can find at '{folder}' folder.
- **Monitor Your Task**: Keep an eye on your task's progress and check its current status at any time.
- **Download Results**: Once completed, you can download the results and reporting tables directly from here.
- **View Your Dashboard**: Your results will automatically populate the dashboard, making it easy to review and analyze the data.
Just follow the steps provided on this page to smoothly manage and retrieve your calculation outputs.

veg_layer.description:
SDG indicator 15.4.2 makes use land cover data to evaluate and monitor land cover change and its estimated impact in terms of ecosystem degradation and recovery.
Please indicate below if you wish to use a set of custom land cover maps of your country to compute both indicators. If not, the tool will use the land cover time series produced by the European Space Agency (ESA) under the Climate Change Initiative (CCI) as a default global solution (For further information on this dataset, please check http://maps.elie.ucl.ac.be/CCI/viewer/index.php)

task_report.description:
This section helps you retrieve calculations running in the background on Google Earth Engine.

- Locate your task file in `{folder}`.
- Check whether the calculation has completed and download its reporting tables.
- Results from the current calculation can populate its dashboard. Earlier calculations remain historical reports with their original settings.

Follow the steps below to retrieve your calculation outputs.
